_meta.purpose: Fonte canônica de avatares (ICP) pro seletor da UI /criar e pro skill 04 (image-prompt-engineer). Eixo COMBINADO: segmento (quem aparece + onde) + variante (registro emocional do sujeito). Afeta SÓ a imagem — a copy no modo wizard é digitada pelo usuário.

regras_globais.dignidade: NUNCA retratar o empresário de forma acusatória, humilhante ou caricata. A dor aparece com dignidade (avatar.md §5.5). Tiago provoca, não humilha (mito-fundador-tiago).
regras_globais.paridade_genero: Paridade real entre compradores (avatar.md §1). Variar gênero entre o prompt principal e os fallbacks. Persona masculina e feminina fornecidas em cada segmento.
regras_globais.brasilidade: Sempre decisor brasileiro 35-55, pele variando (light olive, warm brown, light). Nunca americano/Hollywood/Silicon Valley.
regras_globais.moderacao_segura: Cenas sem conteúdo sensível, sem nudez, sem violência, sem sofrimento explícito — evita bloqueio de moderação do gpt-image-2. Exaustão = ombros levemente caídos + olhar pensativo, nunca corpo em sofrimento.
regras_globais.linhas_vermelhas: Nunca 'successful businessman', sorriso stock, thumbs up, comemoração, ring light, terno de luxo Faria Lima, estética de ostentação (avatar.md §17 linhas vermelhas + _base.md anti-padrões).

segments.label: Varejo · Pet shop / agropet
segments.ui_desc: Dono de rede ou loja de pet/agropet. Ex: Hiperzoo.
segments.case_anchor: Hiperzoo (rede de pet shop, 110 colaboradores, +141% em vendas)
segments.clothing: casual button-up shirt or polo, sleeves often rolled up, no tie
segments.persona_male: Brazilian man, light olive skin, dark short hair, well-trimmed beard, casual button-up shirt
segments.persona_female: Brazilian woman, warm light skin, dark hair pulled back, minimal jewelry, casual blouse or light blazer
segments.environment: inside a modern Brazilian pet retail store, shelves of pet products and a grooming area softly blurred in the background, natural store lighting

segments.label: Varejo · Farmácia / drogaria
segments.ui_desc: Dono de farmácia ou rede de drogarias. Ex: Brava.
segments.case_anchor: Brava (rede de farmácias, +16% ticket médio, 5 recordes de venda)
segments.clothing: smart business shirt or light blazer, neat and practical
segments.persona_male: Brazilian man, warm brown skin, short black hair, clean-shaven, smart business shirt with sleeves rolled up
segments.persona_female: Brazilian woman, light skin, shoulder-length dark hair, structured blazer over blouse
segments.environment: on a Brazilian pharmacy/drugstore floor, medicine shelves and the front counter softly blurred, even overhead retail light

segments.label: Varejo · Ótica / joalheria
segments.ui_desc: Dono de ótica, joalheria ou semi-joias. Ex: Ótica Visão, Órex.
segments.case_anchor: Ótica Visão (rede de óticas, recorde em 30 anos) / Órex (semi-joias)
segments.clothing: elegant but understated — silk blouse or tailored shirt, refined
segments.persona_male: Brazilian man, light skin, short brown hair, thin metal-frame glasses, tailored shirt no tie
segments.persona_female: Brazilian woman, warm light skin, dark hair, tasteful minimal jewelry, structured camel blazer over silk blouse
segments.environment: inside an upscale Brazilian eyewear or jewelry boutique, glass display cases with soft reflections softly blurred, warm boutique lighting

segments.label: Varejo · Construção / decoração / móveis
segments.ui_desc: Dono de loja de material de construção, decoração ou móveis.
segments.case_anchor: Segmento prioritário do ICP (varejo de construção/decoração)
segments.clothing: practical button-up or polo, durable, hands-on look
segments.persona_male: Brazilian man, light olive skin, short hair, light beard, practical button-up shirt
segments.persona_female: Brazilian woman, warm light skin, hair pulled back, practical blazer over plain top
segments.environment: in a Brazilian home-improvement or decor showroom, aisles of building materials or furniture softly blurred, bright warehouse-retail light

segments.label: Serviço · Advocacia / clínica / escritório
segments.ui_desc: Dono de escritório de advocacia, clínica, consultório ou prestação B2C.
segments.case_anchor: Segmento prioritário do ICP (serviço relacional B2C)
segments.clothing: smart business shirt or navy blazer no tie, professional but not corporate-cold
segments.persona_male: Brazilian man, warm brown skin, short black hair, clean-shaven, navy blazer over open shirt
segments.persona_female: Brazilian woman, light skin, dark hair pulled back, dark navy blazer over blouse, minimal jewelry
segments.environment: in a Brazilian professional-services office with wooden furniture, framed diplomas or bookshelves softly blurred, soft natural window light

segments.label: Indústria · B2B pequena/média
segments.ui_desc: Dono de indústria B2B com venda relacional. Ex: Ambi, CBA Diesel.
segments.case_anchor: Ambi Soluções Acústicas (indústria) / CBA Diesel (rede de filiais)
segments.clothing: wool sweater over shirt or button-up, grounded and experienced
segments.persona_male: Brazilian man, light skin, short grey-flecked hair, glasses, wool sweater over a collared shirt
segments.persona_female: Brazilian woman, warm light skin, dark hair, structured blazer, confident and grounded
segments.environment: in a small Brazilian industrial / B2B setting, a clean factory floor or warehouse with concrete and metal textures softly blurred, mixed natural and overhead light

segments.label: Genérico · Empresário (sem segmento)
segments.ui_desc: Empresário brasileiro em geral, ambiente neutro. Use quando o segmento não importa.
segments.case_anchor: Empresário em ponto de inflexão (definição-mãe do ICP, avatar.md §1)
segments.clothing: smart-casual button-up or sweater over shirt, no tie
segments.persona_male: Brazilian man, light olive skin, short dark hair, well-trimmed beard, smart-casual button-up
segments.persona_female: Brazilian woman, warm light skin, dark hair pulled back, structured blazer over plain top
segments.environment: in front of a clean off-white textured wall in a modern studio, or a generic modern Brazilian small-business office softly blurred, soft natural light

variants.label: Padrão · Empresário em ponto de inflexão
variants.ui_desc: O dono que construiu na intuição e bateu no teto da própria capacidade. Registro neutro.
variants.emotional_cue: serious confidence with a quiet trace of fatigue, decision-grade reflective gaze, dignified
variants.posture: mid-shot from chest up, body slightly angled toward camera, looking off-frame in thought
variants.dor_ref: avatar.md §1 — o empresário em ponto de inflexão

variants.label: Decide sozinho
variants.ui_desc: Carrega o negócio sem co-decisor. Mais cansaço e solidão da liderança. Incidência maior em mulher solo.
variants.emotional_cue: quiet exhaustion but dignified, the weight of deciding everything alone, calm solitude — never suffering, never defeated
variants.posture: alone in the frame, no other people, reflective and self-contained, slight shoulder drop
variants.gender_lean: skews female-solo but keep parity — alternate between a woman and a man across prompt and fallbacks
variants.dor_ref: avatar.md §16 Variante A + §5.6 solidão da liderança

variants.label: Técnico que virou empresário
variants.ui_desc: Era advogado, médico, engenheiro, vendedor bom. Cresceu fazendo, nunca aceitou virar gestor.
variants.emotional_cue: pensive and slightly out of place in the manager role, mid-thought, the discomfort of having become a manager without choosing it — dignified, not anxious
variants.posture: caught between doing and managing, glancing toward the operation around them, hands suggesting they'd rather be doing the technical work
variants.dor_ref: avatar.md §16 Variante B + §5.9 'não me reconheço mais no que faço'

variants.label: Herdeiro / continuador
variants.ui_desc: Entrou pra ajudar os pais ou sócio mais velho e ficou. Peso de modernizar o que outro construiu.
variants.emotional_cue: quiet responsibility and respect, the weight of modernizing a legacy built by someone else, careful and grounded — never arrogant
variants.posture: slightly younger than the segment average, standing in an established/older business setting, looking at something built before them
variants.dor_ref: avatar.md §16 Variante C — culpa silenciosa de 'estragar' o legado
